PurchaseDocumentTerm_value_check.name: PurchaseDocumentTerm_value_check
PurchaseDocumentTerm_value_check.value: ("PurchaseDocumentTerm"."calcType" = 'PERCENT' AND "PurchaseDocumentTerm"."rate" IS NOT NULL) OR ("PurchaseDocumentTerm"."calcType" = 'AMOUNT' AND "PurchaseDocumentTerm"."inputAmount" IS NOT NULL)

PurchaseTerm_distribute_check.name: PurchaseTerm_distribute_check
PurchaseTerm_distribute_check.value: NOT "PurchaseTerm"."distributeToLines" OR (NOT "PurchaseTerm"."isProductwise" AND "PurchaseTerm"."allocationBasis" IS NOT NULL)

SalesDocumentTerm_value_check.name: SalesDocumentTerm_value_check
SalesDocumentTerm_value_check.value: ("SalesDocumentTerm"."calcType" = 'PERCENT' AND "SalesDocumentTerm"."rate" IS NOT NULL) OR ("SalesDocumentTerm"."calcType" = 'AMOUNT' AND "SalesDocumentTerm"."inputAmount" IS NOT NULL)

PurchaseChallanLine_expiry_check.name: PurchaseChallanLine_expiry_check
PurchaseChallanLine_expiry_check.value: "PurchaseChallanLine"."manufactureDate" IS NULL OR "PurchaseChallanLine"."expiryDate" IS NULL OR "PurchaseChallanLine"."expiryDate" >= "PurchaseChallanLine"."manufactureDate"

PurchaseBillLine_expiry_check.name: PurchaseBillLine_expiry_check
PurchaseBillLine_expiry_check.value: "PurchaseBillLine"."manufactureDate" IS NULL OR "PurchaseBillLine"."expiryDate" IS NULL OR "PurchaseBillLine"."expiryDate" >= "PurchaseBillLine"."manufactureDate"
